company.name: Netradyne
company.shortDescription: Netradyne engages in improving fleet safety through computer vision and in-depth data analysis.
company.description:
Netradyne engages in improving fleet safety through computer vision and in-depth data analysis. Through processing visual and sensory inputs, the company targets industries where the timeliness of actionable data is a key differentiator of performance.

There is a continuing technology movement that is driving rapid improvements in camera technology together with reductions in the cost of sensors, processing, and connectivity. These improvements, along with advancements in deep learning technology, have created a perfect opportunity to deliver vision-based solutions across multiple industries.

aiResearchSummary.text: Netradyne is researching intelligent driving monitoring and driver behavior monitoring, using computer-vision based methods for advanced driver assistance and autonomous driving. Work such as Combination alerts and Lane violation alerts detects co occurring events and lane violations to generate in cab and remote warnings. Systems like Virtual safety manager and Coachable driver risk groups curate video, classify driving events, and generate driver scores and virtual coaching. These efforts span driver monitoring, risk scoring, alerting, coaching, and edge based video analytics.
